# MORT 1,891 Feature Registry

This registry contains exactly 1,891 accepted atomic capabilities. Platform implementations are one capability, not separate Swift and Flutter feature counts. Statuses are evidence-bound and roadmap entries are not implementation claims.

## Summary

| Metric | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Accepted capabilities | 1891 |
| Duplicate candidates removed | 24 |
| Unsafe or invalid candidates rejected | 24 |

The JSON and CSV files beside this document contain the same complete records in machine-readable form.

## MORT-F-0001 - Opportunity Radar feed personal control

- **feature_id:** MORT-F-0001
- **unique_slug:** teen-work-opportunity-radar-feed-personal-control
- **title:** Opportunity Radar feed personal control
- **category:** Teen earning and work experience
- **subcategory:** discovery
- **primary_user:** teen
- **secondary_user:** adult, guardian
- **real_world_problem:** Teen workers have limited experience, fragmented tools, and uneven access to safe local opportunity. For opportunity radar feed, People need to configure this capability for their real circumstances.
- **user_story:** As a teen, I want opportunity radar feed personal control so I can get a trustworthy outcome without unsafe workarounds.
- **detailed_behavior:** Provides bounded setup, safe defaults, preview, edit, and reset for opportunity radar feed.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It replaces vague workarounds with an explicit user choice. In MORT, that value is tied to a concrete, authorized local-work outcome.
- **reason_users_return:** Their safe work history, skills, goals, and repeat relationships become more useful over time.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT adapts this capability for ages 13-17, local work, explainable trust, approximate-location privacy, optional Guardian Mode, and free safety controls.
- **safety_impact:** Must preserve age, block, report, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, and account-restriction rules.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color status, and accessible errors.
- **privacy_impact:** Collect only minimum data; keep exact teen location, private messages, evidence, and sensitive records nonpublic.
- **monetization_relationship:** Core capability; optional perks cannot reduce safety, privacy, access, or fair opportunity.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** shared SwiftUI + Flutter Web + Supabase where authority is required
- **swift_path:** not_started
- **flutter_path:** not_started
- **backend_tables:** design_required - additive schema only if persistence or authority is needed
- **rpc_edge_function:** design_required - checked RPC or Edge Function if client writes are unsafe
- **storage_requirement:** none identified
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-preserving adoption and outcome metrics; exclude sensitive traits and exact teen location.
- **notification_requirement:** Only for time-sensitive user value and only with category preferences; otherwise none.
- **moderation_requirement:** Report and block remain available; add routine moderation only when content risk exists.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Required before release for youth-work, jurisdiction, privacy, safety, or claims review; no compliance claim.
- **dependencies:** Authenticated profile; role authorization; loading, empty, error, success, and recovery states; shared safety policy.
- **estimated_effort:** XL
- **expected_impact:** medium
- **retention_score:** 4
- **safety_score:** 4
- **accessibility_score:** 3
- **growth_score:** 3
- **revenue_score:** 1
- **differentiation_score:** 3
- **complexity_score:** 4
- **risk_score:** 4
- **implementation_priority:** 55
- **implementation_status:** accepted_roadmap
- **verification_evidence:** none - accepted roadmap capability only
- **test_status:** not_started
- **Mac_required:** true
- **iPhone_required:** true
- **manual_dashboard_required:** false
- **reason_deferred:** Accepted roadmap item; not implemented in this pass. Requires dependency design and scoped safety/accessibility review.
- **implementation_wave:** Wave 2 - repeat value

- **title:** Voluntary guardian linking message, identity, and control boundary
- **category:** Optional Guardian Mode
- **subcategory:** linking
- **primary_user:** guardian
- **secondary_user:** teen
- **real_world_problem:** Families need optional safety support that does not become mandatory surveillance or block teen independence. For voluntary guardian linking, A trusted contact should not gain identity documents, all messages, earnings, or impersonation authority.
- **user_story:** As a guardian, I want voluntary guardian linking message, identity, and control boundary so I can get a trustworthy outcome without unsafe workarounds.
- **detailed_behavior:** Server policies expose only granted safety-circle records and no unrestricted profile, evidence, message, or location history.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It prevents optional support from becoming surveillance. In MORT, that value is tied to a concrete, authorized local-work outcome.
- **reason_users_return:** Relevant, bounded visibility helps guardians support work without monitoring everything.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT adapts this capability for ages 13-17, local work, explainable trust, approximate-location privacy, optional Guardian Mode, and free safety controls.

- **accessibility_impact:** Requires semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color status, and accessible errors.
- **privacy_impact:** High privacy impact: minimize sensitive identity, incident, and location data; enforce purpose-bound access, retention, audit, and nonpublic defaults.
- **monetization_relationship:** Core capability; optional perks cannot reduce safety, privacy, access, or fair opportunity.

- **storage_requirement:** none; Safety Circle never grants identity-document access
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-preserving adoption and outcome metrics; exclude sensitive traits and exact teen location.
- **notification_requirement:** Only for time-sensitive user value and only with category preferences; otherwise none.
- **moderation_requirement:** Report and block remain available; add routine moderation only when content risk exists.

## MORT-F-0441 - Job-specific contracts

- **feature_id:** MORT-F-0441
- **unique_slug:** legal-trust-job-specific-contracts
- **title:** Job-specific contracts
- **category:** Job lifecycle, scheduling, and execution
- **subcategory:** legal, payment, and first-party trust foundation
- **primary_user:** all users
- **secondary_user:** system
- **real_world_problem:** Teen-safe local work needs enforceable, privacy-minimized legal, payment, identity-signal, and reviewer boundaries instead of informal promises or client-owned authority.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want job-specific contracts so the exact protection is understandable, reviewable, and enforced without overstated legal or identity claims.
- **detailed_behavior:** Creates an immutable, versioned agreement for every accepted job with exact scope, timing, location-release state, hazards, payment obligation, proof, cancellation, and both-party confirmations.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It converts a high-risk informal process into a specific, auditable capability with honest limits and a safe unavailable state.
- **reason_users_return:** Durable version history, clear status, correction paths, and bounded access reduce repeated setup while preserving participant agency.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT applies this boundary to ages 13-17 local work, optional Guardian Mode, private evidence, human review, and no authoritative identity claim without an approved provider.
- **safety_impact:** Core free protection; preserves report, block, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, anti-retaliation, emergency, appeal, and account-restriction controls.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires plain language, semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color state, accessible errors, and an equivalent route where movement or biometrics are unavailable.
- **privacy_impact:** Minimizes data and denies public access to exact teen location, legal records, disputes, identity media, face data, provider secrets, and reviewer-only evidence.
- **monetization_relationship:** Required legal, trust, accessibility, and safety foundation; it cannot be paywalled or used to force an upgrade.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** SwiftUI source + Flutter Web/PWA + hosted Supabase backend
- **swift_path:** swift_mort/MORT/Features/Jobs/ContractPaymentViews.swift
- **flutter_path:** flutter_mort/lib/features/legal/contract_payment_screens.dart
- **backend_tables:** job_contracts, job_contract_versions, job_contract_acceptances, job_payment_obligations
- **rpc_edge_function:** confirm_job_contract_version
- **storage_requirement:** No public sensitive-media storage; use existing private evidence storage only when the authorized workflow requires it
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-safe state, latency, and failure metrics only; exclude legal text, disputes, raw evidence, identity data, face media, addresses, secrets, and reviewer notes.
- **notification_requirement:** Only privacy-minimized, user-owned status or action reminders with preferences and no sensitive preview content.
- **moderation_requirement:** High-impact decisions require purpose-bound trained human review, immutable audit context, correction, and appeal; automation is never final authority.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Attorney and jurisdiction review required before public launch or reliance on legal terms, minor contracts, payment enforcement, identity processing, liveness, appearance review, or real evidence operations.
- **dependencies:** Hosted Supabase Auth, RLS, checked RPCs, exact-version state, private storage where applicable, accessible error/recovery states, and documented operational readiness.
- **estimated_effort:** XL
- **expected_impact:** very_high
- **retention_score:** 4
- **safety_score:** 3
- **accessibility_score:** 2
- **growth_score:** 4
- **revenue_score:** 2
- **differentiation_score:** 3
- **complexity_score:** 4
- **risk_score:** 4
- **implementation_priority:** 100
- **implementation_status:** shared_implemented
- **verification_evidence:** supabase/migrations/20260719050000_legal_contract_payment_foundation.sql#create table public.job_contracts; scripts/qa-job-contract-immutability.mjs#qa-job-contract-immutability; swift_mort/MORT/Features/Jobs/ContractPaymentViews.swift#struct JobContractReviewView; flutter_mort/lib/features/legal/contract_payment_screens.dart#class JobContractScreen
- **test_status:** Hosted legal/trust QA passed; Flutter analyze/tests/release web build and Swift repository static audit passed where applicable.
- **Mac_required:** true
- **iPhone_required:** true
- **manual_dashboard_required:** false
- **reason_deferred:** Attorney, child-safety, labor, privacy, and operational approval remain; real identity collection stays disabled; Mac/Xcode and physical-iPhone validation remain where applicable.

## MORT-F-0704 - Appearance-consistency review

- **feature_id:** MORT-F-0704
- **unique_slug:** legal-trust-appearance-consistency-review
- **title:** Appearance-consistency review
- **category:** Trust, verification, reputation, and references
- **subcategory:** legal, payment, and first-party trust foundation
- **primary_user:** all users
- **secondary_user:** system
- **real_world_problem:** Teen-safe local work needs enforceable, privacy-minimized legal, payment, identity-signal, and reviewer boundaries instead of informal promises or client-owned authority.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want appearance-consistency review so the exact protection is understandable, reviewable, and enforced without overstated legal or identity claims.
- **detailed_behavior:** Allows assigned trained adults to record a limited appearance-consistency review for synthetic QA while prohibiting persistent facial recognition, reusable embeddings, and identity-proven claims.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It converts a high-risk informal process into a specific, auditable capability with honest limits and a safe unavailable state.
- **reason_users_return:** Durable version history, clear status, correction paths, and bounded access reduce repeated setup while preserving participant agency.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT applies this boundary to ages 13-17 local work, optional Guardian Mode, private evidence, human review, and no authoritative identity claim without an approved provider.
- **safety_impact:** Core free protection; preserves report, block, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, anti-retaliation, emergency, appeal, and account-restriction controls.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires plain language, semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color state, accessible errors, and an equivalent route where movement or biometrics are unavailable.
- **privacy_impact:** Minimizes data and denies public access to exact teen location, legal records, disputes, identity media, face data, provider secrets, and reviewer-only evidence.
- **monetization_relationship:** Required legal, trust, accessibility, and safety foundation; it cannot be paywalled or used to force an upgrade.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** Hosted Supabase backend with RLS and synthetic remote QA
- **swift_path:** not_applicable - backend, operations, or Flutter explanation
- **flutter_path:** not_applicable - backend, operations, or native iOS capability
- **backend_tables:** appearance_review_cases, appearance_review_assignments, appearance_review_decisions
- **rpc_edge_function:** submit_appearance_review_decision
- **storage_requirement:** Private, randomized, retention-bound storage only if readiness gates later permit collection; current QA contains no real identity or face media
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-safe state, latency, and failure metrics only; exclude legal text, disputes, raw evidence, identity data, face media, addresses, secrets, and reviewer notes.
- **notification_requirement:** Only privacy-minimized, user-owned status or action reminders with preferences and no sensitive preview content.
- **moderation_requirement:** High-impact decisions require purpose-bound trained human review, immutable audit context, correction, and appeal; automation is never final authority.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Attorney and jurisdiction review required before public launch or reliance on legal terms, minor contracts, payment enforcement, identity processing, liveness, appearance review, or real evidence operations.
- **dependencies:** Hosted Supabase Auth, RLS, checked RPCs, exact-version state, private storage where applicable, accessible error/recovery states, and documented operational readiness.

## MORT-F-0754 - Live-presence replay protection

- **feature_id:** MORT-F-0754
- **unique_slug:** legal-trust-live-presence-replay-protection
- **title:** Live-presence replay protection
- **category:** Safety, fraud, abuse, and incident prevention
- **subcategory:** legal, payment, and first-party trust foundation
- **primary_user:** all users
- **secondary_user:** system
- **real_world_problem:** Teen-safe local work needs enforceable, privacy-minimized legal, payment, identity-signal, and reviewer boundaries instead of informal promises or client-owned authority.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want live-presence replay protection so the exact protection is understandable, reviewable, and enforced without overstated legal or identity claims.
- **detailed_behavior:** Binds each synthetic challenge to one nonce, one short expiration window, and one result so a second submission or stale recording is rejected instead of treated as success.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It converts a high-risk informal process into a specific, auditable capability with honest limits and a safe unavailable state.
- **reason_users_return:** Durable version history, clear status, correction paths, and bounded access reduce repeated setup while preserving participant agency.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT applies this boundary to ages 13-17 local work, optional Guardian Mode, private evidence, human review, and no authoritative identity claim without an approved provider.
- **safety_impact:** Core free protection; preserves report, block, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, anti-retaliation, emergency, appeal, and account-restriction controls.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires plain language, semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color state, accessible errors, and an equivalent route where movement or biometrics are unavailable.
- **privacy_impact:** Minimizes data and denies public access to exact teen location, legal records, disputes, identity media, face data, provider secrets, and reviewer-only evidence.
- **monetization_relationship:** Required legal, trust, accessibility, and safety foundation; it cannot be paywalled or used to force an upgrade.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** Hosted Supabase backend with RLS and synthetic remote QA
- **swift_path:** not_applicable - backend, operations, or Flutter explanation
- **flutter_path:** not_applicable - backend, operations, or native iOS capability
- **backend_tables:** live_presence_challenges, live_presence_results
- **rpc_edge_function:** private.record_live_presence_result
- **storage_requirement:** Private, randomized, retention-bound storage only if readiness gates later permit collection; current QA contains no real identity or face media
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-safe state, latency, and failure metrics only; exclude legal text, disputes, raw evidence, identity data, face media, addresses, secrets, and reviewer notes.
- **notification_requirement:** Only privacy-minimized, user-owned status or action reminders with preferences and no sensitive preview content.

## MORT-F-1164 - Live-presence accessibility alternative

- **feature_id:** MORT-F-1164
- **unique_slug:** legal-trust-live-presence-accessibility-alternative
- **title:** Live-presence accessibility alternative
- **category:** Accessibility, inclusion, localization, and assistive support
- **subcategory:** legal, payment, and first-party trust foundation
- **primary_user:** all users
- **secondary_user:** system
- **real_world_problem:** Teen-safe local work needs enforceable, privacy-minimized legal, payment, identity-signal, and reviewer boundaries instead of informal promises or client-owned authority.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want live-presence accessibility alternative so the exact protection is understandable, reviewable, and enforced without overstated legal or identity claims.
- **detailed_behavior:** Offers a nonpunitive manual alternative when a person cannot perform a requested movement and records the limitation without inferring disability, health, emotion, or identity.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It converts a high-risk informal process into a specific, auditable capability with honest limits and a safe unavailable state.
- **reason_users_return:** Durable version history, clear status, correction paths, and bounded access reduce repeated setup while preserving participant agency.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT applies this boundary to ages 13-17 local work, optional Guardian Mode, private evidence, human review, and no authoritative identity claim without an approved provider.
- **safety_impact:** Core free protection; preserves report, block, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, anti-retaliation, emergency, appeal, and account-restriction controls.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires plain language, semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color state, accessible errors, and an equivalent route where movement or biometrics are unavailable.
- **privacy_impact:** Minimizes data and denies public access to exact teen location, legal records, disputes, identity media, face data, provider secrets, and reviewer-only evidence.
- **monetization_relationship:** Required legal, trust, accessibility, and safety foundation; it cannot be paywalled or used to force an upgrade.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** SwiftUI source + Flutter Web/PWA + hosted Supabase backend
- **swift_path:** swift_mort/MORT/Features/Trust/FirstPartyTrustViews.swift
- **flutter_path:** flutter_mort/lib/features/legal/trust_foundation_screens.dart
- **backend_tables:** live_presence_challenges, team access and review records
- **rpc_edge_function:** request_live_presence_accessibility_alternative
- **storage_requirement:** Private, randomized, retention-bound storage only if readiness gates later permit collection; current QA contains no real identity or face media
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-safe state, latency, and failure metrics only; exclude legal text, disputes, raw evidence, identity data, face media, addresses, secrets, and reviewer notes.
- **notification_requirement:** Only privacy-minimized, user-owned status or action reminders with preferences and no sensitive preview content.
- **moderation_requirement:** High-impact decisions require purpose-bound trained human review, immutable audit context, correction, and appeal; automation is never final authority.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Attorney and jurisdiction review required before public launch or reliance on legal terms, minor contracts, payment enforcement, identity processing, liveness, appearance review, or real evidence operations.
- **dependencies:** Hosted Supabase Auth, RLS, checked RPCs, exact-version state, private storage where applicable, accessible error/recovery states, and documented operational readiness.

## MORT-F-1259 - Teen plain-language terms summary

- **feature_id:** MORT-F-1259
- **unique_slug:** legal-trust-teen-plain-language-terms-summary
- **title:** Teen plain-language terms summary
- **category:** Onboarding, activation, education, and first-use experience
- **subcategory:** legal, payment, and first-party trust foundation
- **primary_user:** all users
- **secondary_user:** system
- **real_world_problem:** Teen-safe local work needs enforceable, privacy-minimized legal, payment, identity-signal, and reviewer boundaries instead of informal promises or client-owned authority.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want teen plain-language terms summary so the exact protection is understandable, reviewable, and enforced without overstated legal or identity claims.
- **detailed_behavior:** Presents a teen-readable summary before the full versioned agreement while keeping the complete draft accessible and separating optional Guardian Mode from legal consent requirements.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It converts a high-risk informal process into a specific, auditable capability with honest limits and a safe unavailable state.
- **reason_users_return:** Durable version history, clear status, correction paths, and bounded access reduce repeated setup while preserving participant agency.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT applies this boundary to ages 13-17 local work, optional Guardian Mode, private evidence, human review, and no authoritative identity claim without an approved provider.
- **safety_impact:** Core free protection; preserves report, block, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, anti-retaliation, emergency, appeal, and account-restriction controls.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires plain language, semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color state, accessible errors, and an equivalent route where movement or biometrics are unavailable.
- **privacy_impact:** Minimizes data and denies public access to exact teen location, legal records, disputes, identity media, face data, provider secrets, and reviewer-only evidence.
- **monetization_relationship:** Required legal, trust, accessibility, and safety foundation; it cannot be paywalled or used to force an upgrade.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** SwiftUI source + Flutter Web/PWA + hosted Supabase backend
- **swift_path:** swift_mort/MORT/Features/Settings/LegalCenterView.swift
- **flutter_path:** flutter_mort/lib/features/legal/legal_screens.dart
- **backend_tables:** legal_documents, legal_document_versions, legal_role_requirements
- **rpc_edge_function:** get_my_legal_requirements, submit_legal_acceptance
- **storage_requirement:** No public sensitive-media storage; use existing private evidence storage only when the authorized workflow requires it
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-safe state, latency, and failure metrics only; exclude legal text, disputes, raw evidence, identity data, face media, addresses, secrets, and reviewer notes.
- **notification_requirement:** Only privacy-minimized, user-owned status or action reminders with preferences and no sensitive preview content.
- **moderation_requirement:** High-impact decisions require purpose-bound trained human review, immutable audit context, correction, and appeal; automation is never final authority.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Attorney and jurisdiction review required before public launch or reliance on legal terms, minor contracts, payment enforcement, identity processing, liveness, appearance review, or real evidence operations.
- **dependencies:** Hosted Supabase Auth, RLS, checked RPCs, exact-version state, private storage where applicable, accessible error/recovery states, and documented operational readiness.

- **real_world_problem:** New users abandon setup when value, role boundaries, age rules, or next steps are unclear. For onboarding progress restore, People cannot easily tell what is required before acting.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want onboarding progress restore readiness guidance so I can get a trustworthy outcome without unsafe workarounds.
- **detailed_behavior:** Explains prerequisites, unavailable reasons, and a safe next step for onboarding progress restore.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It reduces uncertainty before a real commitment. In MORT, that value is tied to a concrete, authorized local-work outcome.

- **safety_impact:** Must preserve age, block, report, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, and account-restriction rules.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color status, and accessible errors.
- **privacy_impact:** Collect only minimum data; keep exact teen location, private messages, evidence, and sensitive records nonpublic.

- **moderation_requirement:** Report and block remain available; add routine moderation only when content risk exists.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Review required if teen data, advertising, employment, or policy claims change.

- **unique_slug:** onboarding-activation-approximate-area-setup-guided-workflow
- **title:** Approximate area setup guided workflow
- **category:** Onboarding, activation, education, and first-use experience
- **subcategory:** location
- **primary_user:** all users
- **secondary_user:** guardian
- **real_world_problem:** New users abandon setup when value, role boundaries, age rules, or next steps are unclear. For approximate area setup, First-time or occasional users need support at the moment of action.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want approximate area setup guided workflow so I can get a trustworthy outcome without unsafe workarounds.
- **detailed_behavior:** Guides approximate area setup through loading, empty, error, success, and cancellation states.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It makes a real marketplace task easier to complete. In MORT, that value is tied to a concrete, authorized local-work outcome.
- **reason_users_return:** Recoverable setup gets each role to a useful first action and remains available for later learning.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT adapts this capability for ages 13-17, local work, explainable trust, approximate-location privacy, optional Guardian Mode, and free safety controls.
- **safety_impact:** Must preserve age, block, report, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, and account-restriction rules.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color status, and accessible errors.
- **privacy_impact:** Collect only minimum data; keep exact teen location, private messages, evidence, and sensitive records nonpublic.
- **monetization_relationship:** Core capability; optional perks cannot reduce safety, privacy, access, or fair opportunity.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** shared SwiftUI + Flutter Web + Supabase where authority is required
- **swift_path:** not_started
- **flutter_path:** not_started
- **backend_tables:** design_required - additive schema only if persistence or authority is needed
- **rpc_edge_function:** design_required - checked RPC or Edge Function if client writes are unsafe
- **storage_requirement:** none identified
- **analytics_requirement:** Privacy-preserving adoption and outcome metrics; exclude sensitive traits and exact teen location.
- **notification_requirement:** Only for time-sensitive user value and only with category preferences; otherwise none.
- **moderation_requirement:** Report and block remain available; add routine moderation only when content risk exists.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Review required if teen data, advertising, employment, or policy claims change.
- **dependencies:** Authenticated profile; role authorization; loading, empty, error, success, and recovery states; shared safety policy.

- **title:** Completion and review reminders idempotent recovery
- **category:** Notifications, reminders, and re-engagement
- **subcategory:** completion
- **primary_user:** all users
- **secondary_user:** guardian
- **real_world_problem:** Users miss important work changes, but excessive or sensitive alerts create noise and privacy risk. For completion and review reminders, Retries, cancellations, and concurrent actions can split state.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want completion and review reminders idempotent recovery so I can get a trustworthy outcome without unsafe workarounds.
- **detailed_behavior:** Makes completion and review reminders safe to retry, rejects stale transitions, and preserves valid user input.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It keeps real work moving during interruption. In MORT, that value is tied to a concrete, authorized local-work outcome.
- **reason_users_return:** Configurable notices return users to a specific valuable action.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT adapts this capability for ages 13-17, local work, explainable trust, approximate-location privacy, optional Guardian Mode, and free safety controls.
- **safety_impact:** Must preserve age, block, report, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, and account-restriction rules.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color status, and accessible errors.
- **privacy_impact:** Collect only minimum data; keep exact teen location, private messages, evidence, and sensitive records nonpublic.
- **monetization_relationship:** Core capability; optional perks cannot reduce safety, privacy, access, or fair opportunity.
- **free_or_paid:** free

- **notification_requirement:** Opt-in, quiet-hour aware, privacy-safe preview, typed destination, and deduplication required.
- **moderation_requirement:** Report and block remain available; add routine moderation only when content risk exists.
- **legal_review_requirement:** Review required if teen data, advertising, employment, or policy claims change.

## MORT-F-1552 - Two-person appearance-mismatch review

- **feature_id:** MORT-F-1552
- **unique_slug:** legal-trust-two-person-appearance-mismatch-review
- **title:** Two-person appearance-mismatch review
- **category:** Admin, moderation, support, and operations
- **subcategory:** legal, payment, and first-party trust foundation
- **primary_user:** admin
- **secondary_user:** support staff
- **real_world_problem:** Teen-safe local work needs enforceable, privacy-minimized legal, payment, identity-signal, and reviewer boundaries instead of informal promises or client-owned authority.
- **user_story:** As a admin, I want two-person appearance-mismatch review so the exact protection is understandable, reviewable, and enforced without overstated legal or identity claims.
- **detailed_behavior:** Prevents one reviewer from finalizing a consequential synthetic appearance mismatch and requires a distinct second trained reviewer plus an appeal or alternative path.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It converts a high-risk informal process into a specific, auditable capability with honest limits and a safe unavailable state.
- **reason_users_return:** Durable version history, clear status, correction paths, and bounded access reduce repeated setup while preserving participant agency.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT applies this boundary to ages 13-17 local work, optional Guardian Mode, private evidence, human review, and no authoritative identity claim without an approved provider.
- **safety_impact:** Core free protection; preserves report, block, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, anti-retaliation, emergency, appeal, and account-restriction controls.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires plain language, semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color state, accessible errors, and an equivalent route where movement or biometrics are unavailable.
- **privacy_impact:** Minimizes data and denies public access to exact teen location, legal records, disputes, identity media, face data, provider secrets, and reviewer-only evidence.
- **monetization_relationship:** Required legal, trust, accessibility, and safety foundation; it cannot be paywalled or used to force an upgrade.
- **free_or_paid:** free
- **platform_scope:** Hosted Supabase backend with RLS and synthetic remote QA

- **unique_slug:** admin-operations-incident-evidence-review-incident-role
- **title:** Incident evidence review specialized incident-manager role
- **category:** Admin, moderation, support, and operations
- **subcategory:** evidence
- **primary_user:** admin, safety staff
- **secondary_user:** support staff
- **real_world_problem:** Teen-safety operations require restricted evidence, accountable decisions, escalation, and durable support workflows. For incident evidence review, Routine admins should not browse allegations or safety evidence.
- **user_story:** As a admin, safety staff, I want incident evidence review specialized incident-manager role so I can get a trustworthy outcome without unsafe workarounds.
- **detailed_behavior:** Restricts incident evidence and high-impact actions to incident, child-safety, senior safety, or legal-review roles as appropriate.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It limits sensitive access to trained responsibilities. In MORT, that value is tied to a concrete, authorized local-work outcome.
- **reason_users_return:** Queues and audit trails let staff resolve incidents consistently as the marketplace grows.
- **reason_it_is_different:** MORT adapts this capability for ages 13-17, local work, explainable trust, approximate-location privacy, optional Guardian Mode, and free safety controls.
- **safety_impact:** Must preserve age, block, report, Safety Ping, prohibited-work, and account-restriction rules.
- **accessibility_impact:** Requires semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color status, and accessible errors.
- **privacy_impact:** High privacy impact: minimize sensitive identity, incident, and location data; enforce purpose-bound access, retention, audit, and nonpublic defaults.
- **monetization_relationship:** Core capability; optional perks cannot reduce safety, privacy, access, or fair opportunity.

## MORT-F-1701 - Official legal-pattern research corpus

- **real_world_problem:** Teen work data, messages, evidence, location, and consent require transparent controls and strict authorization. For message privacy, Unstructured marketplace information creates omissions and inconsistent decisions.
- **user_story:** As a all users, I want message privacy structured input so I can get a trustworthy outcome without unsafe workarounds.
- **detailed_behavior:** Captures the minimum relevant fields for message privacy with accessible validation and safe defaults.
- **reason_users_value_it:** It improves quality without collecting unrelated data. In MORT, that value is tied to a concrete, authorized local-work outcome.

- **accessibility_impact:** Requires semantic labels, responsive text, keyboard or focus support, non-color status, and accessible errors.

- **moderation_requirement:** Report and block remain available; add routine moderation only when content risk exists.
